name: pattern-dump-docs
description: The website (site/) and its style guide (styleguide/), as npm workspaces. The site is content only; its look comes from the style guide package.

scripts.build: npm run lint:css && npm run build -w @pattern-dump-docs/site
scripts.pages: npm run lint:css && npm run build -w @pattern-dump-docs/site && npm run build -w @pattern-dump-docs/styleguide -- --base /workbench/ && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs
